name: MCP Readiness
description: Free scanner for remote MCP servers: checks OAuth discovery, tool annotations, Origin/CORS and estimates tool-list token cost per agent turn. Web scan, README badge, GitHub Action, and an MCP tool.
author: Om3rr

tools.name: scan_mcp_server
tools.description: Read-only readiness scan of a public Streamable HTTP MCP server you are authorized to test. Returns a score, estimated tokens per turn, key findings, and a link to the full results page. Rate-limited. Surface checks only, not a security audit.

url.description: https URL of the MCP endpoint to scan
